info.title: Fantazoo (ITA)
info.synopsis: Trasposizione animata di una serie olandese di fumetti a strisce, ancora oggi pubblicata da diversi quotidiani e settimanali dei Paesi Bassi, intitolata Ox Tales (traducibile letteralmente dall'inglese come I racconti del bue) e creata da Wil Raymakers e Thijs Wilms. In un mondo di matrice agreste dove la natura è incontaminata e popolata di ogni sorta di animale antropomorfo, si svolgono le esileranti avventure di un bue e della sua amica tartaruga Alvaro è un gran lavoratore, forte, ingegnoso e sempre carico di ottimismo. Il bue (conosciuto con il nome di Alvaro nell'edizione italiana) è amolto altruista, ma il più delle volte nel tentativo di aiutare gli altri animali del bosco finisce per complicare la vita a tutti, compreso se stesso creando situazioni comiche che lo vedono, suo malgrado, protagonista.

episodes.title: Ciao Alvaro,La fattoria di Alvaro
episodes.synopsis: Boes and Tad are rafting down the river enjoying themselves. All of a sudden the raft starts to bud changing the raft into a jungle. As Boes` view is obstructed he is unable to control the raft. It hits a rock and Boes and Tad are thrown down a waterfall. They manage to swim ashore. They like what they see around them and Boes decides to build his house there...

episodes.title: Pronto soccorso Alvaro,Lavoro ai campi
episodes.synopsis: Boes starts his work early in the morning. His milch cows` breast are swollen, almost reaching the ground. To solve the problem he puts faucets on the cows` to milk them automatic. He then has to train an untamed horse, which is not easy. This is not all, he has to colect eggs, take care of the sheep, chop wood etc. etc....The animals do not help at all...

episodes.title: La polipo mongolfiera,La famiglia Bidon
episodes.synopsis: The phone rings. Boes takes his first-aid-kit and runs out. Some animals are injured and some are ill. Boes takes care of them all day, taking out a nail, bandaging etc. He is in high spirit, but.....

episodes.title: Mamma Pink scappa di casa,Toby il guardiano
episodes.synopsis: Boes is happy and full of vigor working the field. He plows and plants seeds of carrots and spinach. While working the birds pick the seeds. The hens eat the seeds from his seed bag. Boes plants the hens together with the seed and to his surprise: the hens bud and egg flowers bloom. The moles are trouble-makers, making burrows, destroying the whole field. Boes gets a good idea. He will attempt to challenge the moles...

episodes.title: Scavando un pozzo,Rino innamorato
episodes.synopsis: Boes and Tad find an octopus lying unconscious on the beach. They decide to save his life by pumping air into the octopus. The octopus inflates like a balloon and begins to float. Boes and Tad then decide to tie a basket on the octopus` arms so that they can have a journey. Before long the weather changes for the worse, the wind blows the balloon far away and it finally lands in the middle of a desert...

episodes.title: Niente pesca,Costruire i nidi
episodes.synopsis: It`s time for breakfast. The Biton family who are all big eaters can`t wait for Boes to feed them and fall in the feeder. Tad eats too much and his shell falls apart. The birds steal the food from the dog. However, the Bitons eat more then the others. They eat and eat and eat....

episodes.title: Il Piccolo Canguro
episodes.synopsis: Ping is sick and tired of taking care of her children. They are always a nuisance. She really wants to have a rest and take a nap. All the piglets want is to be fed. She disappears leaving her husband (Biton) with the small ones. Boes finding out that Biton can`t cope alone, he tries to hire babysitters. In the end they all refuse to work because the piglets are noisy.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Tays is a good-for-nothing dog. He tries as hard as he can, but he always makes a mess out of it. Boes asks him to watch the hens. The hens knowing that Tays is not a good watch dog, do what ever they like. Even thought the hens ignore and snub him, Tays even sits on their eggs. The hens are not afraid when the fox arrives. They even make friends with him (ignoring Tays)

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: The well runs dry. Boes starts digging with a mallet trying to strike water and finally reaches the centre of the Earth. Everytime he strikes, The Tokyo Tower sinks and the Pyramids shake. He finally manages to reach the navel of the Earth and tickles, making the Earth burst into laughter. The water at the end splashes and carries Boes as far as the Pacific Ocean...

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Rhino falls in love with a female rihno called Saila. However, he`s got a rival who is another rhino with a tough and big horn. It seems like Saila likes Rhino`s rival better. So Rhino challenges his rival to a duel, this doesn`t work as Rhino`s horn is as soft as a balloon. Boes knowing how lonely Rhino is gets an idea. He sharpens Rhino`s horn and then have him challenge his rival again...

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Boes goes fishing and gathers an earthworm. The earthworm however doesn`t feels like being swalloed by a fish and tries to escape. Boes tries to persuade him, but the earthworm will not listen. When a fish tries to swallow the earthworm it swalloes the fish instead...

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: It`s noisy in the forest. Everywhere young birds are born. Some fall onto the ground a peep frantically. Finding that the nests are too small for the birds, Boes decided to make boxes. However, they look funny and the birds don`t like them. Even though the birds ignore the boxes, Boes is happy and in high spirits...

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: Mother kangaroo has two ill-mannered kangaroos, who often disappear from home. Her pouch is very useful, it`s used as a cradle, a trampoline or a ring for wrestling. What`s more when it rains the pouch becomes a swimming pool. Her two never appreciate it. One day they disappear again to see the world. Before long, the are caught by an eagle, but they are so ill-mannered that the eagle returns them back to their mother.

episodes.title: Episodio 14
episodes.synopsis: Boes declares that he is an expert archer. Tad says he is good with a slingshot. They both state that they are better than the other and decide to have a contest to find out who is better. Actually their weapons never hit the target. They then decide to go hunting. Boes being very softhearted hesitates to shoot smaller animals. The animals start making a fool out of Boes. When he finally shoots his arrow, it turns around and chases Boes. Tad saves him with his slingshot and Boes has to admit that Tad is good...

episodes.title: Episodio 15
episodes.synopsis: A calf is born at Boes` farm. While mother cow is feeding the calf, a mole appears and steals the milk using a straw. The calf gets angry as it feels all the milk is his. It starts sucking on all the nipples at the same time. Then when Boes comes to milk the cow, the calf attacks Boes and runs after him...

episodes.title: Episodio 16
episodes.synopsis: It`s very cold inside of Boes` house which is no wonder as it is snowing very hard. Penguins start appearing from Boes` fridge, Tad`s shell is frozen hard so that he can`t even stick his head out. Boes tries to help by opening the shell. The shell falls apart and Tad is totally stripped and trembling with cold. The Boes tries to shovel the snow and builds an Iglo, which doesn`t work either. Then Boes goes skiing...

episodes.title: Episodio 17
episodes.synopsis: The woodpeckers begin to give their young ones intensive training to become good woodpeckers. The young woodpeckers peck the tries trying to find the insects and go too far sometimes. They even peck a whale`s back which irritates the whale who then spouts water. They peck on anything they find on their way getting all the animals in the forest angry. One morning even Boes finds his wooden clogs changed into...??

episodes.title: Episodio 18
episodes.synopsis: Dynaking the untamed horse is so wild that he does not let Boes shoe him. Boes tries to make friends with him by giving him carrots etc., but the horse ignores Boes. Boes wants to ride Dynaking anyway and finally manages to put a saddle on. Dynakings gets very depressed and is even outrun by a duck. When a green catterpillar hangs infront of his face he runs in panic and thus wins the race in the end.

episodes.title: Episodio 19
episodes.synopsis: Rambau the gorilla is a trouble maker. He always does whatever he feels like doing. While Boes and Tad harvest apples, he grabs some and throws them at Boes and Tad. Boes gets angry and throws the apples back at Rambau. Rambau is not scared of anything, he is awfully noisy. Boes and Tad don`t know what to do with him...

episodes.title: Episodio 20
episodes.synopsis: Donking is a male lion. His thundering roar gives the other animals the shudders, makes Boes almost lose his hearing. To be frank Donking has lost most of his mane. In order to disguise this fact, Dinking uses his tail as a wig. The female lion encourage him to keep his dignity as king of the beasts. This is not easy for him as his is too soft hearted...

episodes.title: Episodio 21
episodes.synopsis: Boes and Tad are relieved when the mother of Ellen, the baby elephant, comes to pick her up. They found it quite tiring to babysit as Ellen cried a lot, ate a lot and was as mischievous as a monkey. They learn that there is no way to reason with a little elephant. However to Boes` surprise Tad turned out to be a good babysitter...

episodes.title: Episodio 22
episodes.synopsis: It looks like there will be a large harvest of sugar beets, corn and tomatoes this year. However it hasn`t rained for a long time and the weather is very hot. It`s so hot that the featehrs of Gourmesh are parched, Zebras sweat so much that they loose their stripes etc. etc. Boes offers prayers for rain and it finally starts raining. But it rain so hard that the animals are now almost swept away. Boes` house has swept away. Finally it stops and a beautiful rainbow appears, but...

episodes.title: Episodio 23
episodes.synopsis: Boes goes fishing. A big fish swallows the bait, but Boes can`t get it out of the water. He loses confidence in his physical strength and starts to train. 1st of all he challenges Rambau the gorilla and Phat Elephant to arm wrestle, but fails. Next he tries to lift barbells, but falls on his back. He then takes up weightlifting etc., which becomes a nuisance to the animals in the forest...

episodes.title: Episodio 24
episodes.synopsis: Boes has delicious cheese. One day he cuts a piece of cheese and finds out that it`s hollow inside. Boes sets a trap to catch the rat that has been munching on his cheese. He of course gets caught in the trap himself. After speaking to Tad he decides to get a cat. Even though the cat looks big and strong, it actually is a very lazy one...

episodes.title: Episodio 25
episodes.synopsis: Cal Rabbit is lazy and a big eater. One day he gets fed up of leading a boring life an decides to see what the rest of the world looks like. Boes and Tad worry about Cal, but he is smart enough to survive the hardship of the world outside. He even finds himself a pretty girlfriend. What`s more he gets better at stealing carrots from Boes` field...

episodes.title: Episodio 26
episodes.synopsis: Boes and Tad go on a picknic. They go by boat. They run after butterflies and pick flowers. When the get hungry the open their hamper. To their surprise they find a hedgehog inside the hamper. The hedgehog runs away with all the bananas and sandwhich leaving only a tin of crabmeat for Boes and Tad. To make it worse they forget to bring a can opener. Boes asks Tad to go back and get it and promises not to start eating, but...

episodes.title: Episodio 27
episodes.synopsis: Mornin` Cock crows in a lovely voice and the hens lay eggs like crazy. Boes is happy and praises Mornin` too much. So Mornin` crows from early morning to sundown, making Boes totally crazy. Boes and Tad get a good idea. They talk about roast chicken and set the table. Mornin` peeps through the window and becomes scared...

episodes.title: Episodio 28
episodes.synopsis: Tad’s shell rolls downhill and falls into a hole. Boes and Tad go down the hole to get the shell back. The hole reaches the edge of a cliff and there is a river at the bottom of the cliff. It seems that Tad’s shell has rolled down to the river. Tad wears leaves and then a mushroom to substitute his shell, but Rambau takes Tad for a funny—looking creature and try’s to eat him. To make it worse, Boes puts a barrel, a bag and then a tub on Tad. Tad demands that he is not doll to dress up. Meanwhile, the crocodile and the eagle carry Tad’s shell away...

episodes.title: Episodio 29
episodes.synopsis: Boes loves honey. one day he follows a honeybee and finds the honeybee’s nest. However, Mark the bear reaches the nest first and eats up all the honey. Drop the bee thinks that Boes has stolen all his honey and Stings Boes. Boes gets enough of sharp pointed things on his back. He wants to lick honey, but Mark gets him wherever he goes, and bee’s impatience are very dangerous...

episodes.title: Episodio 30
episodes.synopsis: Crown the Eagle carries baby rabbits to her nest, where her two chicks hungrily await food. The rabbits bravely fight against the chicks and win. They even eat Crown’s nest. Next Crown carries mice and a crocodile egg to her nest. The chicks peck at the egg, when it cracks a crocodile appears and opens its jaws. The chicks are scared and run. Now Crown has to work very hard to feed her large family. While Boes enjoys fishing, Crown snatches his lunch. Boes wonders when Crown has become a vegetarian...

episodes.title: Episodio 31
episodes.synopsis: Boes finished his farm work for today. He steps on the open—air fire, attempting to put it out, but his clogs catch fire. He dives into a well in order to put out his burning clogs. as he loses his clogs, he starts to make a new pairs, but some are too big and some too small. Boes gets a good idea. The clogs, which are too big for his feet can be used for, water—skiing. Tad uses his shell as a surfboard and the race start...

episodes.title: Episodio 32
episodes.synopsis: Many animal babies are born in this time of the year. Buggy the Stork is busy carrying them to their nests. She gets sick and tired of the work so she leaves it for Boes to carry. Now Boes has to take care it. Then Buggy carries other baby animals such as a baby turtle, a baby ostrich, a baby lion, a baby giraffe, etc. which changes Boes house into a kindergarten for baby animals. Boes and Tad do not know what to do with all these baby animals.

episodes.title: Episodio 33
episodes.synopsis: Gourmesh spends all day looking for worms, with her head in the ground. Boes tells her to stop digging for worms,He wants her to keep an egg warm so that a chick can hatch. Gourmesh does not like the idea, but she has got no choice and sits on the egg. The egg hatches and a cute chick appears, but it does not look at all like its mother. Actually it is a swan’s chick. Before long, the swan’s chick grows up to be a full—grown swan. It swims in the river and flies in the sky, but of course Gourmesh cannot. Seeing that, Boes tries to teach Gourmesh how to swim and fly...

episodes.title: Episodio 34
episodes.synopsis: One day a cute little dachshund named Mary winks at Tays. Of course Tays falls in love with her at first sight. However, Mary is the type who is everybody’s friend and can’t decide on only one man. She’s even nice to the Bull....

episodes.title: Episodio 35
episodes.synopsis: Boes is a terrible golf player but he is crazy about is. Tad tells him that just hitting balls around won’t do him any good and that he should go to a golf course if he wants to practice golf. Learning that he is supposed to hit the ball into a hole when he plays, he asks the moles to dig holes in the ground. Now he has so many holes—in—one that he believes that he is a genius golf player. Tad complains that if Boes golf fever does not cool down it will be too dangerous for others to walk around outside...

episodes.title: Episodio 36
episodes.synopsis: Boes goes fishing in the river, but he doesn’t have even a single bite. Then Buggy appears and catches a lot of fish. Next a pelican appears and catches a lot of fish too. Boes gets upset and throws away his fishing rod. He uses his pants for a net but that idea does not work well. He won’t give up. Now he tries to catch earthworms and then even Gourmesh. Tad feels sorry for Does and sends him a glass bowl with golden fish in it.

episodes.title: Episodio 37
episodes.synopsis: The hens lay eggs and sit on them. While they do so, two of their natural enemies appear. One is Wiler the Fox and the other is Boes. The hens manage to get rid of Wiler, but Boes is a tough one to deal with. He’s got a lot of nerve stealing eggs from the hens. The hens are upset and use the whole bag of tricks in order to protect their eggs from Boes, but...

episodes.title: Episodio 38
episodes.synopsis: Boes takes up flute and now he’s crazy about it, which annoys the animals in the woods. He tries to make a snake dance with his flute, but the snake refuses to dance and closes the lid of the basket. Tad, Boes best friend, tries to be nice to him, but every time Boes plays the flute, his shell is taken apart. Even Tad cannot stand Boes playing flute any longer. Tays hides himself in the ground. Boes is happy to learn that the Hippo enjoys his flute for some reason..

episodes.title: Episodio 39
episodes.synopsis: Mary the Sheep is a tomboy. She won’t listen to Tays the Watchdog who is no good at watching sheep. She kicks lays and runs away, Tays cries. Boes tells Lay to go and find Marry. Tays finds Mary all right, but a lion and a wolf are after Mary. Tays fights with the lion and the wolf to protect Mary, but.

episodes.title: Episodio 40
episodes.synopsis: While Boes plows his fields, Gourmesh comes to catch earthworms. Boes asks Gourmesh to help him plow the fields. Gourmesh just runs around and ruins the fields. While Boes sews seeds, the hens and birds come and pick them all. Boes decides to protect the fields from them and stands in the shape of a scarecrow. Now that the birds are scared away, the rabbits and caterpillars are beginning to eat them all. Now it is a time to be reaping at last. The elephant, the sheep and the horse come and eat all the vegetables. Boes asks Tays to get rid of them, but...

episodes.title: Episodio 41
episodes.synopsis: One day a terribly strong wind blows. The sheep hair is rolled up because of the wind and Tad is sent flying. Even Boes’ house is blown away. Although Boes loses his house, he is not worried, saying that he can sleep anywhere. He puts his bed on a tree, but the Beaver bites the tree trunk and the tree falls down. Then Boes puts up a grass tent, but the Sheep come and eat it all. Now Boes decides to live in a cave, but...

episodes.title: Episodio 42
episodes.synopsis: Tays the dog is jealous of Tiger the Cat, since Boes plays only with the cat and he even lets the cat sleep in his bed. Now Tays is afraid that he will be dismissed if he doesn’t score points with Boes. He tries to cath a mouse but Boes gets angry with him. Tays gets a neurosis at last. Tad feels sorry for Tays and tells Boes to be nice to Tays. One day...

episodes.title: Episodio 43
episodes.synopsis: Pee the Skunk breaks wind that smells awful. Flowers and grass fade and bees fall. Tad and the Lion faint. The Gorilla falls out off the tree. Boes gets an idea and puts a stopper into Peep’s behind in order to block his evil smell. Peep’s belly is full of gas and swells like a balloon. At last the gas removes the stopper. Boes next catches Peep and puts him in a cask. Peep breaks wind in the cask and faints, but...

episodes.title: Episodio 44
episodes.synopsis: An eagle flies. Boes shoots an arrow at the eagle, but the arrow misses the eagle and hits a coconut. The coconut falls onto Rambau’s head. Rambau gets angry and throws the coconut at Boes. The coconut hits Boes on the head and Boes faints. The eagle descends and clutches Boes. Boes asks Tad and Tays to help him and the two catch Boes’ tail. The eagle carries the three away and lets go of them onto a desert. Now the three are lost in a vast area on earth. They dig a hole to reach the other side of the earth, but they get nowhere. Boes cannot stand the perching heat of the sun and shoots an arrow at the sun...

episodes.title: Episodio 45
episodes.synopsis: It’s Boes’ birthday today and Boes is going to have a party. He walks through the woods and asks the animals to visit him with presents. Tad makes a fancy cake for Boes, consulting a Cooking book. He puts the cake on the table and walks out to take a bath, then the Fox and the Cat appear and they eat the cake. Now the party is going to start...

episodes.title: Episodio 46
episodes.synopsis: Banana trees have lots of bananas. Rambau the Gorilla Climbs up the banana trees to eat the bananas. He throws the banana peels away. Phant the Elephant eats Boes’ bananas and throws the banana peels away. Now the ground is full of banana peels. Boes, Tad and other animals step on the banana peels and fall down. They have nothing to do but wait until Rambau and Phant finish eating bananas.

episodes.title: Episodio 47
episodes.synopsis: Larry the Cheetah is a fast runner but never able to catch his game, since he just enjoys the race with his game. He is proud of his shining claws, too, and he always sharpens them. Charra the Little Monkey is very smart and agile. The two are good rivals, but Charra always makes fool of Larry. One day Larry is after Charra, but when Charra disappears all of a sudden...

episodes.title: Episodio 48
episodes.synopsis: Rambau the Gorilla falls in love with a female gorilla named Lyra and spends all day doing nothing. He is Surprised to learn that Lyra is a tomboy, but he won’t give up. He gives Lyra many different presents to make her pay attention to him. He does many different things to please her, but Lyra is superior to him in everything. Seeing Rambau feel small in the presence of Lyra, Boes and Tad decide to cheer him up, but....

episodes.title: Episodio 49
episodes.synopsis: Bura the Crow is a thief. He makes a fool of everyone in the woods, stealing something from them. He steals sausages and cheese from Boes and calls him a fool. Boes is now very angry with him. Boes and Tad decide to teach him a good lesson. They set a trap to catch him but in vain. Dura just takes a nap using Boes’ umbrella and cushion. Seeing this, Boes sets another trap to catch Bura and…

episodes.title: Episodio 50
episodes.synopsis: River the Crocodile has got a big mouth. He is always hungry and awaits his game to come, with his mouth wide open, but he is never able to catch any. Being afraid of River’s horrible—looking teeth, Rabbits, ducks and storks etc. avoid him. One day Boes throws trash into River’s mouth. An alarm clock is in the trash. Every time River walks up to his game, the clock rings. River starts crying...

episodes.title: Episodio 51
episodes.synopsis: Billy the Beaver has gotten married recently. Billy and his wife are busy building their new house while Boes and Tad enjoy fishing. Boes is angry at the beavers because he cannot catch fish as they make terrible noises. Boes starts to grill fish burning the beavers tree branches. Lilly the Beaver’s wife is angry with Boes. The beavers start biting Boes’ table and chair. They bite the hen’s’ coop and lays’ house too....

episodes.title: Episodio 52
episodes.synopsis: Crown the Eagle and Buggy the Stork fly in the sky. Seeing the birds fly, Boes wants to fly too. Tad says to him that he cannot fly since he is not a bird, but Boes won’t listen to Tad. He goes to the hencoop and picks feathers from the hens. He attempts to fly using the feathers, but of course he fails. The hens tremble from cold and sneeze. Next he decides to build a glider, using his bed sheet, pillowcase, underpants, socks etc. No wonder the glider falls. He tries time and time again, but flubs it. Tad wants to make Boes’ dream come true and collects many balloons and...

info.title: Fireball
info.synopsis: La serie si svolge nel 47° millennio e ruota intorno a due robot che abitano in una gigantesca villa; la duchessa ginoide Drossel von Flügel e il suo massiccio servitore aracnoide ciclopico, Gedächtnis. Drossel è stato fabbricato con la mente di una ragazza di 14 anni mentre Gedächtnis con la mente di un uomo sui 50 anni sebbene entrambi siano noti per avere almeno 2.800 anni. Nel corso della storia si scopre che Gedächtnis è legato alla famiglia von Flugel da 2.800 anni e che era suo dovere rimanere al fianco di Drossel per tutto quel tempo. Durante il corso degli eventi, i protagonisti stringono un'amicizia con Schadenfreude, robot simile ad una scimmia, dove quest'ultimo si unisce al gruppo dei due robot.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Drossel insists that Gedächtnis show her some dolphins.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Gedächtnis complains that he is not feeling well and covers his eyes with an eye mask.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Drossel wears a strange, new head accessory that she has found in the tower.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Drossel nags Gedächtnis about letters that were supposed to have been delivered to the tower.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Gedächtnis starts acting strangely one day.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: The tower is attacked by the enemy army.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Drossel announces that they should make amends and peacefully co-exist with the enemy.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Drossel complains to Gedächtnis about improving the décor of the tower.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Drossel tells Gedächtnis that she now wants a pet.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: There is an unending rain over the tower.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: There is mysterious laughter throughout the tower.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Drossel asks Gedächtnis to do something about her new robot friend Schadenfreude.

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: Drossel spends her days playing with her new friend Schadenfreude.

info.title: A Star Brighter Than the Sun
info.synopsis: Sae Iwata è una ragazza più grande della media che prova timidezza per la sua altezza mentre il suo amico d'infanzia Koki, che da piccolo era gracile, crescendo è diventato un bel ragazzo. La ragazza pensava si fossero allontanati, ma durante l'ultimo festival sportivo delle medie si sono riuniti. Ora, arrivati alle superiori, Sae si rende conto di provare dei sentimenti per lui ma anche di non essere l'unica ad essere interessata all'amico. La vera domanda è una sola... per chi prova sentimenti Koki?

episodes.title: Il giorno in cui ho allungato la mano
episodes.synopsis: Sae Iwata è una ragazza un po' robusta per la sua età. Il suo amore, Koki Kamishiro, un tempo delicato e fragile, in terza media è diventato un giovane affascinante e popolare. Dopo anni di silenzio, i suoi sentimenti non sono cambiati. Quando i due fanno coppia per organizzare il festival dello sport, il primo amore di Sae, rimasto a lungo assopito, ricomincia a germogliare.

episodes.title: Chiamami per nome
episodes.synopsis: Sae e Kamishiro finiscono nella stessa classe alle medie. Durante un incarico di raccolta della spazzatura a cui partecipano insieme, Kamishiro litiga con un compagno. Quando Sae si fa avanti, lui instintivamente la chiama col suo nome, riaprendo una finestra sui vecchi ricordi. Nel frattempo, anche un'altra ragazza, Hisui, sembra essere attratta da Kamishiro.

episodes.title: Malgrado la distanza
episodes.synopsis: Sapere che Kamishiro ha una cotta per una persona affligge Sae. Tuttavia, durante una gita scolastica, Sae si ritrova incapace di togliergli gli occhi di dosso. Le sue amiche, Hisui e Kagawa, fanno del loro meglio per aiutarla, ma Sae finisce sempre per mostrare il suo lato più impacciato in presenza di Kamishiro.

episodes.title: Anche quando chiudo gli occhi, tu ci sei
episodes.synopsis: Kamishiro ammette a Sae di provare dei sentimenti per qualcuno, descrivendo la sua cotta come "una stella che brilla più luminosa del sole". Parole che trafiggono il cuore di Sae, ma lei sceglie comunque di sostenerlo. Tuttavia, mentre Kamishiro continua a trattarla come al solito, Sae si ritrova divisa tra i suoi sentimenti e la sua determinazione.

episodes.title: Saltando e dondolando
episodes.synopsis: Dopo la gita scolastica, le classi si sfideranno in un torneo di salto con la corda, e Sae e Kamishiro vengono scelti per far oscillare la corda. Nonostante l'accoppiamento inaspettato, Sae cerca di non fissarsi troppo su Kamishiro. All'inizio delle prove, le cose non vanno lisce come previsto. Un pomeriggio dopo la scuola, Sae vede Kagawa che si esercita da sola dietro la scuola.

episodes.title: Cervello, cuore e coraggio
episodes.synopsis: Sae si prende un giorno libero dalla scuola. Il giorno dopo, Kamishiro si fa male durante l'allenamento della squadra e anche lui si prende un giorno di riposo. Quando si prestano i quaderni per recuperare le lezioni perse, i due iniziano a scambiarsi messaggi. Un piccolo incidente porta Kamishiro a scoprire che a Sae piace qualcuno. Ignaro dei suoi veri sentimenti, la incoraggia a provarci.

episodes.title: Pioggia a ciel sereno
episodes.synopsis: Kamishiro viene selezionato fra i membri principali del cast per lo spettacolo teatrale del Festival dell'Inglese. In difficoltà con questa lingua, si rivolge a Sae per chiederle aiuto. Mentre provano, i due si promettono di vedere un film insieme durante le vacanze estive. Il giorno del festival, l'esibizione della classe procede senza intoppi fino a quando Sae irrompe improvvisamente sul palco.

episodes.title: Dieci anni
episodes.synopsis: Con gli eventi scolastici ormai alle spalle, Sae si butta nelle attività del club. Proprio in quel momento, viene fissata la data per la tanto attesa uscita al cinema con Kamishiro. Tuttavia, un incontro casuale con la cugina di Kamishiro, Subaru, lascia Sae a disagio, poiché le torna in mente una cosa che Kamishiro ha detto una volta riguardo alla sua cotta.

episodes.title: I sentimenti di qualcuno
episodes.synopsis: Dopo il loro appuntamento al cinema, Sae si rende conto ancora una volta che a meno che non esprima i suoi sentimenti, Kamishiro non li noterà mai. Dopo avere appreso da Hisui che la festa scolastica è il momento ideale per le confessioni d'amore, decide di dirglielo all'after-party. Mentre si prepara, Sae trova il dipinto di Subaru vandalizzato e le circostanze fanno sembrare lei la colpevole.

episodes.title: Voci
episodes.synopsis: Mentre procedono i preparativi per lo spettacolo scolastico, Sae cerca di parlare con Kamishiro, ma non sembra mai il momento giusto per farlo. Come se non bastasse, Hisui rivela di aver trascorso la maggior parte del tempo in compagnia di Ayukawa. Proprio quando Sae decide di essere più proattiva, Kamishiro fa una proposta inaspettata.

episodes.title: Una stella senza costellazione
episodes.synopsis: Preoccupata per Subaru, Sae si reca in infermiera. Lì, Kamishiro nota che Subaru cerca di comportarsi bene, e così si offre di aiutarla durante la festa scolastica. Sae sente una fitta di solitudine, poiché aveva programmato di confessargli i suoi sentimenti in quell'occasione. Tuttavia, Kamishiro chiarisce che non sarà disponibile durante il suo turno alla reception con Sae.

episodes.title: A Star Brighter Than the Sun
episodes.synopsis: Dopo aver sentito che Kamishiro ha intenzione di dichiararsi alla persona che gli piace, Sae confessa impulsivamente i suoi sentimenti. Sopraffatta dall'emozione, scappa, convinta di essere stata rifiutata. Si nasconde nel ripostiglio della palestra, piangendo fino a quando la porta si apre lentamente e appare Kamishiro.

info.title: Unexpectedly Naughty Fukami
info.synopsis: Kaji è una persona benvoluta da tutti, ma in realtà disprezza le persone e di nascosto le valuta. Durante un viaggio di lavoro viene accompagnato da Fukami, un collega che si veste in maniera così trasandata da ricevere uno zero come valutazione. Tuttavia dopo un bagno, la valutazione su Fukami cambia completamente! Inizia così la storia fra un playboy narcisista e un otaku dal corpo attraente...

info.title: Psycho Armor Govarian
info.synopsis: Nel bel mezzo di un'invasione su larga scala da parte di alieni extra-dimensionali, lo scienziato ribelle alieno Zeku riunisce un gruppo di adolescenti dotati di vari poteri psichici, tra cui Isamu. Una volta a bordo della nave di Zeku… e abbracciata la sua missione di difendere la razza umana dall'estinzione… Isamu e i suoi compagni utilizzano l'energia mentale per creare enormi armature con cui combattere l'Impero Garadain. Nel corso della serie, i membri del gruppo si scontrano tra loro, si innamorano e combattono ovunque sia necessario per proteggere la Terra, che sia a casa, nello spazio profondo o persino mentre sono intrappolati sul pianeta alieno stesso.

info.title: The Ramparts of Ice (ITA)
info.synopsis: Socialmente incapace di relazionarsi con gli altri, Koyuki Hikawa crea un muro fra lei e le persone che la circondano. Trascorre il suo tempo al liceo in solitudine fino a quando non incontra Minato Amemiya, un ragazzo che cerca di accorciare la distanza tra loro per qualche motivo. Koyuki e Minato, la popolare Miki e il gentile Yōta, questa è la storia di quattro giovani un po' complicati che sono confusi dalle proprie vite!

episodes.title: Linee e muri
episodes.synopsis: Davanti allo spavento dei compagni di classe, Koyuki prova a fare smorfie allo specchio per capire perché fa loro paura. All'improvviso, un ragazzo le si avvicina.

episodes.title: Fabbro
episodes.synopsis: Koyuki tira un sospiro di sollievo quando Yota corre in suo aiuto. Dopo aver studiato insieme, si sentono sempre più a loro agio e questo mette Minato in difficoltà.

episodes.title: Distanza
episodes.synopsis: Infastidito dal fatto che Koyuki mantenga ancora le distanze con lui, Minato cerca di fare conversazione. Miki comincia a dubitare delle intenzioni del ragazzo e lo affronta.

episodes.title: Impenetrabile
episodes.synopsis: Miki insiste e Minato chiarisce l'interesse che prova per l'amica di lei. Una visita inattesa fa riaffiorare brutti ricordi per Koyuki, scatenando una dura reazione.

episodes.title: Cambiamento
episodes.synopsis: Koyuki riflette sul confronto carico di tensione avvenuto in infermeria e, quando Yota chiarisce la situazione, cerca per la prima volta di parlare in modo sincero con Minato.

episodes.title: Nuovo quadrimestre
episodes.synopsis: Con la fine delle vacanze invernali il sempre pacato Minato inizia a rendersi conto che i suoi sentimenti stanno cambiando. Miki nota quanto Yota e Koyuki si siano avvicinati.

episodes.title: Ognuno è solo a modo suo
episodes.synopsis: Dopo aver riflettuto sulla propria solitudine e preoccupata che Yota tenga tutto dentro, Koyuki lo contatta per chiedergli cosa provi davvero.

episodes.title: Sullo Stesso Piano
episodes.synopsis: Determinata a dare il massimo al liceo, Miki ha finto di essere una persona diversa fin dal primo giorno. Ma non poter essere se stessa con i compagni di classe comincia a pesarle.

episodes.title: Consapevolezza
episodes.synopsis: Minato si rende conto che Koyuki non gli esce mai dalla testa. Più tardi, mentre sono al nuovo centro commerciale, il malinteso tra i quattro amici si aggrava.

episodes.title: Primavera
episodes.synopsis: Una gita al luna park durante le vacanze di primavera rafforza il legame tra i quattro amici. Di ritorno a scuola, Koyuki è sorpresa da un volto familiare e Minato se ne accorge.

episodes.title: Inversione
episodes.synopsis: Koyuki broods over her complicated past with Akine's sister, Manatsu, and what the first year might know. Meanwhile, Momoka sets her sights on Minato.

episodes.title: Fulmine a ciel sereno
episodes.synopsis: As Koyuki slowly notices her new, surprising feelings towards Minato, first-year Momoka suddenly tries to cozy up to her — for reasons she can't grasp.

episodes.title: Consapevolezza
episodes.synopsis: With Akine's words ringing in her head, Koyuki's feelings become complicated. Later, an accident causes something to shift between Miki and Yota.

episodes.title: Episodio 14
episodes.synopsis: Unsure of how to move forward, Miki avoids Yota and confides in her colleagues. A bold Momoka confronts Koyuki about Minato and lights a fuse.

info.title: Horimiya (ITA)
info.synopsis: Hori può sembrare un'ordinaria adolescente, ma in realtà è una persona completamente diversa dopo la scuola: in assenza dei suoi genitori lavoro-dipendenti, Hori è stata come una madre per il fratellino sin da quando era piccola. Tra il prendersi cura del fratello, sfamare entrambi, e sbrigare le faccende domestiche, non ha molto tempo per una normale vita da adolescente. Un giorno incontra qualcun altro che non è quello che sembra a scuola: un tranquillo, occhialuto ragazzo di nome Miyamura. Le aveva dato l'impressione di un topo di biblioteca, e forse di un otaku, ma Hori non poteva sbagliarsi di più. Al di fuori della scuola, Miyamura è un ragazzo socievole con una marea di piercing e per giunta non è nemmeno molto bravo nello studio. Ora i due hanno qualcuno con cui condividere le due metà celate della propria vita!

episodes.title: Una piccola casualità
episodes.synopsis: Hori-san lives a double life: trendy, popular girl at school, simple, strong-willed caretaker at home. After a chance encounter with her classmate Miyamura, she finds out that she’s not the only one who hides her true self away.

episodes.title: Indossi più di una faccia
episodes.synopsis: When her mother asks about Miyamura, Hori comes to a frightening realization. Later, the Student Council ropes Hori into extra work, but when conflict arises, it's up to Miyamura to smooth things over.

episodes.title: Ecco perché va bene
episodes.synopsis: Miyamura reflects on his past and present. Hori responds to Remi's selfish demand. A heated conversation between Ishikawa and Miyamura ends with a fistfight.

episodes.title: Tutti amano qualcuno
episodes.synopsis: The student council room becomes a cool hangout. Hori tries to get Miyamura flustered. An old friend brings out a new side of Miyamura. Later, when Hori gets sick, Miyamura comes to her rescue.

episodes.title: Non posso dirlo ad alta voce
episodes.synopsis: A rumor complicates Hori and Miyamura's budding relationship. Kyosuke comes home to roost and instantly takes a liking to Miyamura. Sakura evaluates her friendship with Remi.

episodes.title: Questa estate sarà molto calda
episodes.synopsis: Miyamura ends up staying the night. Rumors spread like wildfire at school. Shindo calls the couple over to share a bag of candy. A second-year girl begins to stalk Miyamura.

episodes.title: Tu sei qui, io sono qui
episodes.synopsis: Sakura finds the courage to get closer to Toru. Yoshikawa struggles to voice what she truly wants. Miyamura goes away for a week-long trip. Hori worries about her horror obsession.

episodes.title: L'inganno che svela la verità
episodes.synopsis: Remi reflects on how she and Sengoku started dating. Miyamura discovers a hidden side of Hori. When Yoshikawa gets asked out, the gang gets Ishikawa to help.

episodes.title: È difficile, ma non impossibile
episodes.synopsis: Miyamura runs into some unfriendly faces. Hori tries to get Miyamura to fulfill her darkest desires. Mizouchi's love is unrequited. Tanihara confronts his past with Miyamura.

episodes.title: Finché non si scioglierà la neve
episodes.synopsis: Hori has an unexpected demand of Miyamura. When Yoshikawa learns her fake relationship with Ishikawa might be coming to an end, she's forced to reflect on her own feelings.

episodes.title: Potrebbe sembrare odio
episodes.synopsis: The gang tries to get Yanagi to loosen up. Iura is clueless as to how much he terrifies Sawada. When Iura’s sister Motoko is struggling with entrance exams, Iura asks Hori to help.

episodes.title: Fin qui, e anche in futuro
episodes.synopsis: Yoshikawa heads over to Ishikawa's house. Christmas brings romantic holiday cheer to all. Hori and Miyamura discuss their future.

episodes.title: Ti regalerei il cielo
episodes.synopsis: As graduation approaches, Miyamura reflects on the past year, an uncertain future, and the new life he’s found.

info.title: Magilumiere Magical Girls Inc. 2
info.synopsis: Seconda stagione di Magilumiere Magical Girls Inc.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: At a conference among industry leaders in Kaii countermeasures, Shigemoto's "Alice System" is rejected due to lack of proven results. He takes on a massive yet dangerous new project for himself to prove his abilities while questioning the industry's power dynamics and expectations. Meanwhile, a certain individual approaches Koshigaya with a suspicious proposal, putting her father on shaky ground.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Kana and Koshigaya visit the RIMT to investigate and exterminate a new Kaii species. Guided by Vice Chief Akasaka, they face a bewildering and seemingly invincible Kaii specimen defying all common sense. Behind the scenes, ulterior motives surrounding magic power regulations cause tension as the Kaii unexpectedly mutates. With a strict time limit, Magilumiere's skills are put to the test.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Magical Girls from Magilumiere and AST simultaneously face a rampaging new Kaii species. Koshigaya extends an olive branch to Tsuchiba, resulting in a clash of opinions that only sparks tension between their companies. The unknown Kaii rapidly mutates under the influence of magic power, after which a certain individual takes control as operator for the do-or-die battle ahead.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: An improvised collaboration between Magilumiere and AST engages in a do-or-die fight against the rapidly mutating Class C Kaii. Magilumiere's fluctuating defensive and offensive tactics upset conventional methods as Kana gathers real-time data during battle to take control. Through physicality, precise control, and high-level guidance, the seemingly unbalanced team devises a plan to counterattack.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Magilumiere begins recruiting engineers to promote the Alice System. Kana struggles to convey the company's appeal while overseeing the interview process. This causes unexpected personnel to assemble, bringing the team a fresh atmosphere. When securing more talent proves difficult after serious attempts to strengthen their combat potential, Magilumiere heads to Kyoto for lectures and interviews.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: In Kyoto, Magilumiere meets engineer candidate Yamimori, who boasts impressive skills but struggles with cooperation. While compatibility with the team is called into question, he appears to be hiding certain feelings about his childhood friend Sakae and his personal values. Meanwhile, during a festival at Tonomori Shrine, a ritual unleashes a Kaii while an ominous shadow lurks behind the scenes.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: At the Tonomori Shrine ceremony's climax, an unknown Kaii suddenly invades a barrier once believed to be safe, enveloping the area in chaos. The barrier blocks outside forces, which separates Magilumiere's team. Makino and Akasaka are forced into a struggle within the barrier while Nikoyama searches for an opening outside. With time running out, each decision will greatly influence the outcome.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: After gaining the trust of his allies, Yamimori takes action to fight the rampaging Kaii inside the sealed barrier. Makino and Akasaka also rechallenge the front lines to face the now-overpowered Kaii with harmonious teamwork and quick thinking. The dire situation demonstrates the skill and trust between Magical Girls and their engineers as the team marches onward with full hearts.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: The Kaii at Tonomori is revealed to be someone's act of sabotage promoting a scheme to ease magic regulations behind the scenes and manipulate public opinion. Then, the culprit emerges-someone entirely unexpected. While Yamimori becomes comfortable at Magilumiere, Kana decides to confront major industry norms and her own role in the process, sparking the onset of war on a much grander scale.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: While deregulation advocates plot their next scheme, Magilumiere defies all precedents by waiting to ambush an enormous, unclassified, and highly irregular Kaii before it emerges. Koshigaya, Akasaka, and Makino struggle on the field as the Kaii's power escalates beyond all expectation while Nikoyama and Yamimori frantically work together on analysis and support from the operator's chair.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: As the battle in Tokyo Bay intensifies, Magilumiere's Magical Girls work together to take control. However, Tsuchiba from AST intervenes to turn the battle on its head with her ultra-powerful new magical device—"Wings"—aiming to single-handedly annihilate the target and contradict Magilumiere's cooperative combat style. Now, with tensions flaring, it's not just a fight against the Kaii anymore.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Amidst the raging war, Magilumiere and AST finally decide to "cooperate" as Shigemoto gives AST full access to the Alice System's technology to combine both companies' power for shared use among their Magical Girls. Meanwhile, Tsuchiba nearly loses control of her magic. For the sake of future generations, new relationships and moral values drive everyone involved to fight with their hearts.

info.title: Mission: Yozakura Family 2 (ITA)
info.synopsis: Seconda stagione di Mission: Yozakura Family 2

episodes.title: Ai dalla famiglia Yozakura/Mini Kyoichiro
episodes.synopsis: Ai, ex dirigente di Tanpopo, si unisce alla famiglia Yozakura, ma la pace dura poco.

episodes.title: Vincitori e perdenti
episodes.synopsis: Taiyo affronta il caos a scuola: la spia di bronzo Sosuke Michibata lo attacca con tranelli e voci.

episodes.title: Il team di guardia del Grande Fratello Shinzo
episodes.synopsis: Lo shopping di Shinzo con Ayaka si trasforma in un caos quando Kengo e Nanao lo aiutano di nascosto.

episodes.title: Esame avanzato per spie
episodes.synopsis: Nella prima fase dell'Esame da Spia, Taiyo affronta Shinzo in una spietata caccia all'uomo.

episodes.title: Il frutto dell'amore
episodes.synopsis: Taiyo affronta Kyoichiro nella terrificante prova finale, dove i candidati svaniscono nell'oscurità.

episodes.title: Nuovi fiori di ciliegio
episodes.synopsis: Taiyo incontra Kawashita per scoprire come uccidere Tsubomi, ma Momo appare all'improvviso.

episodes.title: Alla vecchia Residenza Yozakura
episodes.synopsis: Mutsumi testa i poteri di Taiyo. Futaba non riesce a imparare i segreti della tecnologia da Shion.

episodes.title: La commissione di Ai/La grande missione dieta di Mutsumi
episodes.synopsis: Ai fa una prima faccenda da sola per rallegrare la famiglia. Taiyo e Mutsumi la seguono travestiti.

episodes.title: Tsubomi & Mutsumi
episodes.synopsis: La ricerca di un antico diario si trasforma per gli Yozakura in pulizie caotiche e rivelatrici.

episodes.title: Rifiuto
episodes.synopsis: Kyoichiro scompare. Taiyo percepisce una misteriosa presenza e riceve una chiamata d'emergenza.

episodes.title: perazione Ricerca del Primogenito
episodes.synopsis: Taiyo trova Kyoichiro, che rinnega la famiglia e fugge, creando una frattura tra i fratelli.

episodes.title: Torniamo a essere una famiglia
episodes.synopsis: Avvelenato da Tsubomi, Kyoichiro fugge per salvare la famiglia. Taiyo lo insegue per salvarlo.

info.title: Your Letter
info.synopsis: Sori è una ragazza gentile, premurosa e di sani principi. Sfortunatamente queste sue qualità la rendono anche bersaglio perfetto di bullismo. Si trasferisce quindi in una nuova scuola, e quando sembra che la storia stia per ripetersi, si imbatte in una misteriosa serie di lettere che la condurranno in una magica caccia al tesoro, in un mondo nascosto, sotto la superficie della sua nuova scuola. Un'avventura che la porterà a riscoprire l'amicizia, le meraviglie della natura e la bontà dell'umanità.
